messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Higher and further education in Uruguay during the 1960s?
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: Uruguay historical university enrollment 1960 1970 UNESCO UIS data
Uruguay 1960 higher education students historical statistics dataset
Uruguay anuario estadistico 1960 universidad matricula educacion superior datos
action.query: Uruguay historical university enrollment 1960 1970 UNESCO UIS data

content.text: {"items":[{"title":"University Students' Values, Vocations, and Political Orientations: Uruguay, 1966 (ICPSR 7064)","url_or_doi":"https://www.icpsr.umich.edu/web/ICPSR/studies/7064/versions/V1","justification":"A historical social science dataset specifically examining university students in Uruguay in 1966. Provides information on students' values, vocational aspirations, and political orientations. Particularly relevant for studying the social characteristics, attitudes, and experiences of higher education students during the 1960s."},{"title":"Síntesis de la evolución educativa del Uruguay entre 1956 y 1965","url_or_doi":"https://repositorio.cfe.edu.uy/handle/123456789/1533","justification":"A historical statistical report from Uruguay's Ministry of Public Instruction covering educational developments between 1956 and 1965. Includes enrollment statistics for universities, secondary education, and the Universidad del Trabajo del Uruguay (UTU). Particularly valuable for reconstructing historical datasets on higher education, technical education, and further education during the early 1960s. Data are presented in historical tables rather than as a ready-to-use machine-readable dataset."},{"title":"World Bank Historical Higher Education Statistics for Latin America","url_or_doi":"https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/569831468913826525/pdf/multi-page.pdf","justification":"A World Bank historical statistical publication containing comparative higher education enrollment figures for Latin American countries, including Uruguay. Provides historical observations for 1960 and other benchmark years, drawing on UNESCO statistical yearbooks. Useful for comparing Uruguay's university enrollment with regional trends. Some country-year observations are unavailable."},{"title":"Historical Educational Statistics of Uruguay, 1960–2010","url_or_doi":"https://www.gub.uy/ministerio-desarrollo-social/sites/ministerio-desarrollo-social/files/documentos/publicaciones/558.pdf","justification":"A Uruguayan government statistical publication containing historical education indicators and annual statistical series beginning in 1960. Potentially useful for examining long-term educational participation and comparing the 1960s with subsequent decades. The availability of indicators specifically covering tertiary and technical education during the 1960s should be checked within the publication."},{"title":"University of the Republic Historical Archives – Educational Enrollment and Administrative Records","url_or_doi":"https://archivosdocumentales.udelar.edu.uy/index.php/informationobject/browse?ancestor=539&languages=es&levels=230&media=print&page=2&sf_culture=en&sort=alphabetic&sortDir=desc&topLod=0&view=table","justification":"The University of the Republic's archival catalog identifies historical educational records, including university budget documents from 1965, secondary education enrollment tables, and earlier student statistics. These primary sources can help reconstruct institutional enrollment, educational financing, and transitions into higher education during the 1960s. This is an archival collection rather than a consolidated downloadable dataset."},{"title":"UNESCO Institute for Statistics – Historical Education Data","url_or_doi":"https://data.uis.unesco.org/","justification":"UNESCO's international education statistics database provides standardized indicators covering tertiary education enrollment, educational participation, graduation, and educational institutions. It is useful for investigating Uruguay's historical higher education system and comparing it internationally. Historical coverage varies by indicator, and data availability for individual years during the 1960s must be verified."},{"title":"World Bank – School Enrollment, Tertiary (% Gross), Uruguay","url_or_doi":"https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SE.TER.ENRR?locations=UY","justification":"An internationally standardized dataset measuring gross tertiary education enrollment in Uruguay, sourced from UNESCO. Useful for analyzing the expansion of higher education and comparing enrollment rates with other countries. However, the displayed series begins in 1974, so it does not directly cover the 1960s. It is primarily useful as a supplementary dataset for examining subsequent developments."},{"title":"Uruguay – Sustainable Development, Education, Demographic and Socioeconomic Indicators","url_or_doi":"https://data.amerigeoss.org/dataset/unesco-indicators-for-uruguay","justification":"A dataset collection containing UNESCO education and socioeconomic indicators for Uruguay. Includes information about educational participation, students, and teachers. It may support comparisons between historical and later educational developments, although the identified student and teacher data cover 2000–2001 rather than the 1960s. Consequently, this is a supplementary source rather than a direct historical dataset."}]}
